title.narrative: Strengthening Nigerian Government capacities in pursuit of Durable Solutions in Northeast and Middle Belt.

description.narrative: Strengthening Nigerian government capacities at the federal, state and local levels in pursuit of durable solutions in the Northeast and the Middle Belt.Together, these thematic pillars – strengthening institutional capacities, enhancing data-and-analysis capabilities, and fostering protection-sensitive strategy development and programming – will form the basis of the JPs’ three main outcomes, as described in the results framework:1. Enhanced government capacity for coordination, leadership, and resource mobilization on the federal, state and local levels;2. Data stewardship for evidence-based government interventions; and3. A more effective state government IDP approach through enhanced protection support.
